basis: NVIDIA NVL72 AI Factory Enterprise RA with GB300 NVL72 and Spectrum-X (2026-03), NVIDIA DGX GB Rack Scale User Guide (2026-09), and public OEM GB300 NVL72 rack mechanical/cooling specifications

power_a.spec: IEC 60309 560P6W 3-phase feed A (4x33 kW shelves, N+N)

power_b.spec: IEC 60309 560P6W 3-phase feed B (4x33 kW shelves, N+N)

tcs_supply.spec: Rear rack manifold supply inlet (PG25/treated water, 25-45 degC)

air_in.spec: Front perforated cold-aisle intake (~10% residual air cooling)

fabric_ew_p1.spec: 72x400G Compute E-W Plane 1 (18 trays x 4 rails via ConnectX-8 2x400G breakout)

fabric_ew_p2.spec: 72x400G Compute E-W Plane 2 (mirrored rail-optimized Spectrum-X fabric)

fabric_ns_a.spec: 18x400G Converged N-S Storage/In-band rail A (BlueField-3 B3240)

fabric_ns_b.spec: 18x400G Converged N-S Storage/In-band rail B (BlueField-3 B3240)

oob_mgmt.spec: 2x100G HA uplinks from 2x in-rack DC-powered SN2201 OOB switches (54x1GbE in-rack)

properties.form_factor: OCP ORv3 / NVIDIA MGX Rack Scale
properties.leak_detection: Integrated tray-level and rack-level liquid leakage detection

limitations: 外形尺寸、质量与液冷流阻曲线取自公开参考架构与 OEM 公开选型资料（calibrated-reference）；不同 OEM（HPE/Lenovo/Supermicro 等）的机柜高度、歧管快接头规格与电源鞭接口在施工图阶段须按中标厂商图纸复核。
